Test case title: Verify Edit Screen Initial Load and Pre-population for Case 1 (Current/Future Period)
Precondition: User is authenticated and navigates to 'Edit Tipe Insentif' for a config where valid_from and valid_to are both current or future dates.
Test steps:
1. Open the Edit Tipe Insentif screen for the target config.
2. Observe the breadcrumb navigation path.
3. Verify the status and incentive point name in the read-only header.
4. Verify the 'Berlaku sejak' (valid_from) and 'Berlaku sampai' (valid_to) fields.
5. Verify the rendered Channel boxes, Tipe Salesman boxes, and Slab tables.
6. Verify the editability of date fields, channels, groups, and slab rows.
Expected result:
1. Screen loads successfully via GET endpoint 14.3.
2. Breadcrumb displays 'Manajemen Insentif / Tipe Insentif / Edit Tipe Insentif'.
3. Header displays slab_config.status and incentive_point.incentive_point_name as read-only text.
4. Date pickers are pre-filled with valid_from and valid_to values and are editable.
5. Existing channels, salesperson groups (mapped with levels 1->Sales, 2->SPV/KAO, 3->RSO), and slab thresholds are pre-filled accurately.
6. Case 1 allows full editing: date fields, '+ Tambah Channel', '+ Tipe Salesman', slab inputs, and delete icons are active and editable.

Expected result:

2. 'Berlaku sejak' field is disabled and read-only.
3. 'Berlaku sampai' field remains active and editable.
4. The entire 'Pilih Channel dan Tipe Salesman' section is rendered read-only: '+ Tambah Channel', '+ Tipe Salesman', slab inputs, and delete icons are disabled or hidden.

Test case title: Verify Case 3 Restriction: Edit Action Unavailable When Both valid_from and valid_to are in the Past

Test case title: Verify Save Button Behavior When No Changes are Made (Pristine State)
Precondition: User opens an editable slab config (Case 1) with existing data.
Test steps:

2. Dirty tracking evaluates both is_config_updated and is_slabs_updated to false.
3. 'Simpan' button is disabled or acts as a no-op.

Test case title: Verify Request Payload When Only Dates are Changed (is_config_updated: true, is_slabs_updated: false)

2. Confirmation modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' appears.
3. PATCH request is triggered.
4. Payload contains is_config_updated: true, is_slabs_updated: false, updated_valid_to, and updated_valid_from; the 'groups' array is completely omitted.

Test case title: Verify Request Payload When Both Dates and Slabs are Changed (Both Flags True)
